references.text: The story of when Joshua sent spies to Jericho and Rahab hid them, which is the background for why she and her family were spared
Joshua commands that Rahab and everyone in her house shall live because she hid the messengers
The two spies bring Rahab and her family out before the city is destroyed
Hebrews mentions Rahab's faith when she received the spies and therefore did not perish with the unbelievers
James uses Rahab as an example that faith is shown through deeds, since she received the messengers and sent them out by another route
Rahab is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy as the mother of Boaz
